studies.label: Main five-condition, two-round plastic-pollution ideation experiment

counts_source.locator: PDF p. 3 (printed p. 10282), Section 3.1; PDF p. 4 (printed p. 10283), Sections 3.6 and 4.1
counts_source.quote: A total of 254 adult participants were initially enrolled, and seven were removed for failing attention checks or offering cursory responses, resulting in a final sample size of 247.

arms.name: Control
arms.description: No external suggestions in either round. Section 3.1 reports n = 50 after the seven stated exclusions; its relation to the later outlier/incomplete-response screening is unresolved (PDF p. 3 (printed p. 10282), Section 3.1; PDF p. 4 (printed p. 10283), Section 3.6).

arms.name: Early-AI-Labeled
arms.description: GPT-4 suggestions introduced in Round 1 under the heading AI-generated ideas, with bold text and an icon. No new external inputs in Round 2; continued access to the original suggestions is unspecified. Section 3.1 reports n = 49 before any unquantified additional screening (PDF p. 3 (printed p. 10282), Sections 3.1 and 3.3-3.4; PDF p. 4 (printed p. 10283), Sections 3.4 and 3.6).

arms.name: Early-AI-Unlabeled
arms.description: The same GPT-4 suggestions introduced in Round 1 under Ideas from others, without explicit AI attribution. No new external inputs in Round 2; continued access is unspecified. Section 3.1 reports n = 49 before any unquantified additional screening (PDF p. 3 (printed p. 10282), Sections 3.1 and 3.3-3.4; PDF p. 4 (printed p. 10283), Sections 3.4 and 3.6).

arms.name: Late-AI-Labeled
arms.description: Unassisted Round 1 followed by GPT-4 suggestions at the start of Round 2, explicitly headed AI-generated ideas. Section 3.1 reports n = 50 before any unquantified additional screening (PDF p. 3 (printed p. 10282), Sections 3.1 and 3.3-3.4; PDF p. 4 (printed p. 10283), Sections 3.4 and 3.6).

arms.name: Late-AI-Unlabeled
arms.description: Unassisted Round 1 followed by the same GPT-4 suggestions at the start of Round 2 under Ideas from others. Section 3.1 reports n = 49 before any unquantified additional screening (PDF p. 3 (printed p. 10282), Sections 3.1 and 3.3-3.4; PDF p. 4 (printed p. 10283), Sections 3.4 and 3.6).

studies.task: Propose innovative, feasible community solutions for reducing urban plastic pollution, then refine, expand, combine, or develop new solutions in the next round.

ai_tool.name: GPT-4
ai_tool.locator: PDF p. 3 (printed p. 10282), Section 3.3: pre-generated GPT-4 suggestions, lightly edited after pilot feedback; no model version or release year is stated
